flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:4175/app?demo then Under Needs you, hover over the row "Bump the checkout form to the new inputs": a Run again button shows on it. Press Run again.
Check that this pull request is now under Kane is checking and says "Kane is checking this pull request again."
Hover over the row "Make the free shipping threshold easier to read" and press the Fix with Claude button on it.
Check that this pull request is now under Claude is fixing and says Claude is fixing Free shipping from €50.

Do each step once, the way it is described. If a click or a key press does something other than what the step expects, the check fails: don't retry it, and don't reach the goal another way (other buttons, links, keyboard shortcuts, typing the URL). Waiting for a slow page to load is fine.
